description: This course teaches the theory and techniques to analyze and improve the visibility of a webpage in search engines via the organic search results without paid ranking promotion, i.e., search engine optimization (SEO). Students will become familiar with the concepts in terms of how search engines work, what people search for, what are the effective search keywords put into the search engines, and how to optimize a website’s ranking visibility by editing its content, structure, and links. In addition, this course also focuses on experiment design, A/B test, ranking algorithms, and machine learning models in the SEO setting. Students are expected to utilize analytics programming skills (R and Python) to conduct field experiment and analyze ranking algorithms to make informed marketing strategy with search engines.
